description: Argument check order of DISC, INTRATE, PRICEDISC, RECEIVED, YIELDDISC, PRICEMAT, YIELDMAT and ACCRINTM: one argument out of its domain (a date below 0, at 0.5 or past 9999-12-31, dates out of order, a zero or negative amount, a negative rate, basis 5 or -1) against NA(), text or TRUE in every other position, and two errors in every pair of positions (T-2484).
